metadata.title: Jake Briningstool sees one target in Week 3
metadata.description: Jake Briningstool failed to catch his only target in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
metadata.analysis: Briningstool has seen minimal involvement in the Kansas City offense early on, recording one target or less in each of the first three games. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Las Vegas Raiders.

metadata.title: Jake Briningstool - Provides versatility in Week 1 opener
metadata.description: Briningstool caught his only target for nine yards and made two tackles in Monday night's 31-10 win over the Broncos.
metadata.analysis: Briningstool played 13 of 69 offensive snaps primarily as a blocker for Kenneth Walker. The tight end's bigger role came on special teams, where he played 20 snaps and made a tackle in kick coverage and punt coverage. Briningstool's success comes after No. 4 tight end Jared Wiley was inactive as a healthy scratch, further showing Briningstool's place on the tight end totem pole.

metadata.title: Jake Briningstool - Involved at training camp
metadata.description: Briningstool (hamstring) is participating in training camp, Jared Sapp of ArrowheadPride.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports that Briningstool caught a great ball from Garrett Nussmeier on Wednesday and appears to be back in playing shape. The tight end missed the 2025 season due to a persistent hamstring injury.

metadata.title: Jake Briningstool - Ruled out again
metadata.description: Briningstool (hamstring) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders.
metadata.analysis: With Briningstool ruled out of Week 18 as well as the Chiefs being eliminated from playoff contention, the undrafted rookie out of Clemson will end the 2025 season without being able to make his NFL debut. The tight end will have to focus on recovering in the offseason so that he can compete for a spot on the Chiefs' 2026 roster.

metadata.title: Jake Briningstool - Ruled out for Thursday
metadata.description: Briningstool (hamstring) has been ruled out ahead of Thursday night's game against the Broncos.
metadata.analysis: Bringingstool logs his second week of full practice, which will not culminate in a game. The undrafted free agent out of Clemson quickly found a home on the Chiefs roster, but has been burdened by a hamstring injury most of the season. With the Chiefs' playoff hopes gone, the team may be overly cautious with young players they have 2026 hopes for, meaning Briningstool may not see action in Week 18 either and will have to wait till 2026 to make his NFL debut.

metadata.title: Jake Briningstool (hamstring) ruled out for Week 16
metadata.description: Jake Briningstool has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Titans.
metadata.analysis: Despite recording three full practices this week, Briningstool will not suit up in week 16.

metadata.title: Jake Briningstool - Won't return Sunday
metadata.description: Briningstool (hamstring) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's matchup against the Titans.
metadata.analysis: Despite practicing in full throughout the week, the Clemson product isn't ready for in-game action just yet. Briningstool has yet to make his NFL debut after catching 49 of 76 targets for 530 yards and seven touchdowns during his final collegiate season. His next opportunity to take the field will come in the Week 17 matchup against the Broncos, though he must still be activated to Kansas City's active roster in order to play.

metadata.title: Jake Briningstool - Practice window opens
metadata.description: The Chiefs announced Wednesday that Briningstool (hamstring) had his practice window opened to return from IR.
metadata.analysis: Briningstool will have a 21-day window to practice without counting against the 53-man roster, and if healthy, he could be activated from IR and return to action as early as Sunday versus the Titans. The depth tight end has missed the entire regular season so far due to a hamstring injury that dates back to the start of training camp.

metadata.title: Jake Briningstool - Starting season on IR
metadata.description: The Chiefs placed Briningstool (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday with a designation to return, per the NFL's transaction log.
metadata.analysis: Briningstool has been working through a hamstring injury since the start of training camp, and the issue is severe enough for him to start the season on IR. He'll be required to miss the first four games of the regular season, making Week 5 against the Jaguars on Monday, Oct. 6 his first opportunity to make his 2025 debut. Briningstool signed with the Chiefs in late April as an undrafted free agent following a four-year college career at Clemson.

metadata.title: Jake Briningstool (hamstring) misses practice Tuesday
metadata.description: Jake Briningstool did not practice on Tuesday.
metadata.analysis: Briningstool has been sidelined since last week as he continues to work his way back from a hamstring injury.

metadata.title: Jake Briningstool (hamstring) absent from practice Thursday
metadata.description: Jake Briningstool remained absent from practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Briningstool has remained absent due to a hamstring injury. He does not have a timetable to return.
